title: Context footprint baseline for 1.39.3: ~16k tokens upfront on hosts that load every tool schema, ~1.8k per prompt, up to ~9k per hunch_context call
observation: Baseline measured 2026-09-20 on the published @davesheffer/hunch@1.39.3 dist in the hunch repo (328 decisions, 51 findings). Tokens = characters / 4, not a tokenizer. FIXED PER SESSION: generated grounding block 9,714 chars (~2.4k tok, 61% of CLAUDE.md; AGENTS.md carries the same 9,788 chars; five grounding files in total); SessionStart hook ~450 tok (counted from the injected text); MCP server instructions 878 chars (~220 tok); tool list — Claude Code defers schemas and pays ~320 tok for 42 names, a host that loads every schema pays 50,866 chars (~12.7k tok) for name+description+inputSchema, or 85,584 chars (~21.4k tok) if it also loads the 6 outputSchemas (30,441 chars). Largest tools: hunch_context ~4.0k, hunch_change_proof ~3.0k, hunch_record_decision ~1.1k. RECURRING: UserPromptSubmit hook ~1,130 chars (~300 tok) on every prompt (counted from the injected text; not re-run because the hook opens a task record), plus the instructed hunch_task start (~250 tok) and finish (~1.2k tok) responses — both estimated from live responses, not scripted; pre-edit hook 6,106 chars (~1.5k tok) for src/mcp/server.ts and 411 chars for src/core/io.ts. TOOL RESULTS: hunch_context(src/mcp/server.ts) at the default 1,500-token budget returns content text of exactly 6,000 chars but structuredContent of 30,348 chars (~7.6k tok): `omitted` alone is 21,047 chars (104 entries repeating one sentence) and `text` repeats the brief; whole result ~9.2k tok, and Claude Code shows the model the structured result. hunch_findings() with no scope returns 25,079 chars (~6.3k tok): 12 of 51 findings with full observation text, no budget or limit. hunch_now() 3,768 chars (~0.9k tok). No test or command measures any of these. Filed as issues #368 (tool list), #369 (grounding block), #370 (per-prompt overhead), #371 (tool results), #372 (measurement gate); roadmap proposal dec_3ca27de266. UNVERIFIED: whether Codex/Cursor/Windsurf put outputSchema into model context; whether any host reads both CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md.
